slides.title:
A terminal you can
talk to.
slides.body: Simple tools in plain words. Workflows that run on any computer.

slides.title: Turn Wi-Fi off and on
slides.body: Say it in plain words. It shows the command and asks first.

slides.title: Join a network
slides.body: The exact command is shown. Nothing changes until you say yes.

slides.title: Close a port
slides.body: It finds what is listening, names it, and stops only that.

slides.title: Quit an app by name
slides.body: It checks what is really running before it closes anything.

slides.title:
Workflows that
run anywhere.
slides.body: Describe the steps once. Get a .flow file that works on macOS, Windows and Linux.

slides.title: Describe it, save it
slides.body: Tell the terminal the steps. Choose where the file goes.

slides.title: Double-click to run
slides.body: Sentinel lists every command and waits for your click.

slides.title: The terminal never opens
slides.body: A workflow that only opens things runs quietly.

slides.title: Sentinel Terminal
slides.body: macOS, Windows and Linux. The AI runs on your computer.
